label: Ancient Civilizations Pack
description: The ancient cultures, kingdoms and empires of every continent, gathered by region (the river cradles, the Mediterranean, Persia, the steppe, Mesoamerica, the Andes, sub-Saharan Africa, Oceania, Southeast Asia and more) — each an atom with its endonym, era and note, its region, and (where curated) its source links and excavation sites.
